name: Glass Railing Bay · 2 m
summary: 2 m centre-spaced glass railing bay with graphite posts, continuous handrail and transparent sea-green panel.
description: 2 m centre-spaced glass railing bay with graphite posts, continuous handrail and transparent sea-green panel.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and Principled BSDF materials. No external models or textures.

assembly.connectors: Post faces at 0.026 m offset; handrail centre at 1.095 m. Use one post at each unique joint and extract only MODULE_Infill for repeated bays.

material_notes: Sea-green glass uses glTF BLEND alpha 0.28 with double-sided surfaces, not refraction/transmission. Thin edge tint makes the glass readable. Original source geometry/materials remain individually editable.
accuracy_notes: Static decorative concept only. Not building-code compliance, a structural engineering design, fabrication instructions, physics simulation or a safety-certified barrier.

attribution.credit: Original geometry and materials authored for Blender-3D-Gallery; no external artwork.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.

quality_gate.scope: Local asset structure/source/visual checks passed. Strict gallery gate has one unresolved request failure; Android and iOS untested. See verification.md.
